name: Jiuquan SLC-43
tagline: China's crewed-spaceflight pad — every Shenzhou crew, every Tianzhou cargo run
description: The first Chinese space launch site (1958), operational orbital launches since 1970, and from 1999 onward the dedicated home of human spaceflight: every Shenzhou crew (1 through 19 as of 2025) has lifted from SLC-43 Pad 91. Tianzhou cargo runs to Tiangong fly Long March 7 from the same complex. Jiuquan is inland in the Gobi desert at 40.96°N — too far north for the equatorial geometry Wenchang handles, but the historic centre of Chinese spaceflight.
best_known_for: China's crewed-spaceflight pad — every Shenzhou crew, every Tianzhou cargo run
